_comment: CHARM 3.0 guard policy. Read by charm_guard.py on every check, so edits apply without restarts. No secrets belong in this file.

allowlists._comment: The user profile's own email and phone are always included. '@domain.com' allows a whole domain.

approval._comment: mode: always | tainted (approval when the session has read external or suspicious content, or a recipient is off the allowlist) | never (approval only for off-list recipients)

screening._comment: llm: also run an LLM classifier on inbound text. block_threshold: refuse inbound requests scoring at or above this (null = flag only, let the tool gates decide).
